body: I have a draft list for the 15 Clinical repos. I can do 20 minutes on Monday the 23rd to confirm those first three owners and decide who will take the other twelve.

Please use that Storefront time log in our account review. I can explain how we prioritized image findings if Fulfillment wants to evaluate the same capability with its service owners.
